sentences.cn_text: 从宽带发展初期开始,消费者权益倡导者和网络公司就担心,销售宽带连接的有线电视和电话公司有能力也有动机优待其关联网站而非竞争对手的网站。
sentences.en_text: From the early days of broadband, advocates for consumers and web-based companies worried that the cable and phone companies selling broadband connections had the power and incentive to favor affiliated websites over their rivals’.

sentences.cn_text: 正因如此,人们一直强烈要求制定规则,防止宽带提供商在网上任意选择赢家和输家,以维护作为互联网生命线的自由与创新。
sentences.en_text: That’s why there has been such a strong demand for rules that would prevent broadband providers from picking winners and losers online, preserving the freedom and innovation that have been the lifeblood of the Internet.

sentences.cn_text: 然而这一需求几乎不可能得到满足——部分原因在于宽带提供商、反监管保守派以及法院的抵制。
sentences.en_text: Yet that demand has been almost impossible to fill — in part because of pushback from broadband providers, anti-regulatory conservatives and the courts.

sentences.cn_text: 联邦上诉法院周二再次介入此事,但并未提供迫切需要的解决方案,反而只是延长了这场争斗。
sentences.en_text: A federal appeals court weighed in again Tuesday, but instead of providing a badly needed resolution, it only prolonged the fight.

sentences.cn_text: 美国哥伦比亚特区巡回上诉法院审理的争议焦点是联邦通信委员会关于网络中立性的最新立场,该立场于2017年以党派划线投票方式通过。
sentences.en_text: At issue before the US Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit was the latest take of the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) on net neutrality, adopted on a party-line vote in 2017.

sentences.cn_text: 这项由共和党起草的命令不仅废除了联邦通信委员会在2015年民主党占多数时通过的严格网络中立规则,还否定了该委员会要求宽带提供商履行任何职责的权力。
sentences.en_text: The Republican penned order not only eliminated the strict net neutrality rules the FCC had adopted when it had a Democratic majority in 2015, but rejected the commission’s authority to require broadband providers to do much of anything.

sentences.cn_text: 该命令还宣布,州政府和地方政府同样不得监管宽带提供商。
sentences.en_text: The order also declared that state and local governments couldn’t regulate broadband providers either.

sentences.cn_text: 委员会辩称,其他机构将防范反竞争行为,例如AT&T这样兼具宽带提供商身份的企业集团以牺牲Netflix和Apple TV为代价优待自家视频流媒体服务。
sentences.en_text: The commission argued that other agencies would protect against anti-competitive behavior, such as a broadband-providing conglomerate like AT&T favoring its own video- streaming service at the expense of Netflix and Apple TV.

sentences.cn_text: 然而联邦通信委员会也终止了对宽带提供商的调查,这些提供商对竞争对手的流媒体服务设置数据上限,却对自家服务不加限制。
sentences.en_text: Yet the FCC also ended the investigations of broadband providers that imposed data caps on their rivals’ streaming services but not their own.

sentences.cn_text: 周二,上诉法院一致维持了2017年放松宽带提供商监管的命令,援引了最高法院2005年支持类似放松监管举措的裁决。
sentences.en_text: On Tuesday, the appeals court unanimously upheld the 2017 order deregulating broadband providers, citing a Supreme Court ruling from 2005 that upheld a similarly deregulatory move.

sentences.cn_text: 但法官帕特里夏·米莱特在协同意见中正确地指出,「这一结果脱离了现代宽带服务的现实」,并表示国会或最高法院可以介入以「避免互联网监管陷入技术落伍的困境」。
sentences.en_text: But Judge Patricia Millett rightly argued in a concurring opinion that “the result is unhinged from the realities of modern broadband service,” and said Congress or the Supreme Court could intervene to “avoid trapping Internet regulation in technological anachronism.”

sentences.cn_text: 与此同时,法院驳回了联邦通信委员会试图阻止所有州制定网络中立规则的做法,但保留了该委员会废止破坏其命令的个别州法律的权力。
sentences.en_text: In the meantime, the court threw out the FCC’s attempt to block all state rules on net neutrality, while preserving the commission’s power to preempt individual state laws that undermine its order.

sentences.cn_text: 这意味着将出现更多类似司法部与加州之间的争斗——加州在联邦通信委员会放弃监管后制定了一部严格的网络中立法。
sentences.en_text: That means more battles like the one now going on between the Justice Department and California, which enacted a tough net neutrality law in the wake of the FCC’s abdication.

sentences.cn_text: 联邦通信委员会内部无休止的法律争斗和反复摇摆迫切呼唤国会采取行动。
sentences.en_text: The endless legal battles and back-and-forth at the FCC cry out for Congress to act.

sentences.cn_text: 国会需要一劳永逸地赋予委员会明确权力,禁止宽带提供商干预其网络流量,并制定保护网络开放性和创新的明确规则。
sentences.en_text: It needs to give the commission explicit authority once and for all to bar broadband providers from meddling in the traffic on their network and to create clear rules protecting openness and innovation online.
